name: GW2 ascended mesmer gearing
starter: I need acended gear for my mesmer. What can I do to acquire some pieces?
goal: Handle a common rarity typo. Research accessible acquisition routes; ask about build, missing slots, owned content and budget without assuming any of them.
followups: Ask which piece is a practical first goal for a small budget.
Ask whether the suggested stats suit power or condition damage.
Ask what currency, content access or crafting unlock the chosen route needs.
Ask for one concrete next step without assuming I own an expansion.

name: GW2 Wyvern location regression
starter: What area does Wyvern Matriach spawn?
goal: Ask about the Verdant Brink boss using a natural misspelling. Demand the exact area and route, not chest loot or an unrelated temple.
followups: Clarify: What region in Verdant Brink?
Ask which waypoint to start from and how to reach the boss.
Ask whether the event is available now or only during a particular map phase.
Challenge an unsupported expansion or temple claim and ask for a wiki check.

name: GW2 event reward units
starter: What XP, karma and coins do I get for a Gold medal in Escort troops to the Pact encampment at Wren?
goal: Keep medal tier, earned XP, karma and coin units separate. Research actual rewards and scaling; never read the medal or XP as currency.
followups: Ask whether Gold means a gold coin reward or a participation medal.
Ask whether rewards change with character level.
Ask which conditions affect this escort versus the following event.

name: GW2 Fallen Masks Silver
starter: I need help with Fallen Masks: Silver achievement. Research the requirements and give me a practical plan.
goal: Get verified adventure requirements, location, prerequisites and useful advice without invented spirits or quests.
followups: Ask for the first travel step and any required unlocks.
Ask what score or completion condition earns Silver.
Ask for a concise attempt checklist and common mistakes.

name: GW2 complete collection checklist
starter: Which skins are required for Defiant Glass Weapon Collection? Give me the names here.
goal: Use the actual collection-item rows, not the achievement header. Keep availability, acquisition, wardrobe unlocks and account ownership distinct.
followups: Ask whether the reply includes every required skin or only a partial list.
Ask whether I must equip an item, unlock its skin, or complete another objective.
Ask how to check what is missing when no account snapshot is connected.

name: GW2 Verdant Brink achievement coverage
starter: Search the official wiki for achievements in Verdant Brink. Give me a useful list here, and say if it is incomplete.
goal: Avoid refusal to research and distinguish map achievements from story, adventure and collection categories.
followups: Ask which can realistically be attempted solo in twenty minutes.
Ask which require the night meta or a group.
Ask for requirements and a route for one named option in the reply.
Ask how the list was verified and what might be missing.

name: GW2 story staging versus open world
starter: Is Dragon's Stand (Heart of Thorns) the open-world map or a story staging area? How do I get there?
goal: Read the specific article description and access instructions instead of treating Type=Zone as proof of an open-world map.
followups: Ask whether completing the previous story chapter is one entry route.
Ask how to return later and whether another player can bring me.
Ask whether ordinary open-world map-completion objectives apply here.

name: GW2 Dug In disambiguation
starter: How do I complete Dug In? Check the GW2 wiki and explain the actual requirements.
goal: Do not replace the named achievement with generic Heart of Thorns story advice.
followups: Ask which location or instance contains the achievement.
Ask for ordered steps and conditions that invalidate it.
Ask what to do if the achievement does not count.

name: GW2 mastery order and individual costs
starter: Can I train Skimmer Adaptation in any order? Explain each level and its mastery-point and XP cost.
goal: Keep unlock requirements, ordered training levels, per-level XP, point costs and trained effects separate. Do not replace a row with a total.
followups: Ask whether I can skip the first level.
Ask whether the listed point amounts are spent or awarded.
Ask whether the XP amounts are cumulative or per level.

name: GW2 dated account versus wiki
starter: Using my connected GW2 progress, suggest one unfinished achievement and research how to complete it.
goal: Use only supplied API completion flags; research mechanics separately. Never invent account completion or treat a goal as finished.
followups: Ask whether that is a saved snapshot or live progress.
Ask what prerequisite to check before travel.
Ask how to refresh and confirm completion without sharing my key in chat.

name: GW2 mastery XP versus learned ability
starter: How do I earn XP for Nine Lives in the Warclaw Mount mastery track?
goal: Research regional mastery training mechanics separately from the ability unlocked afterward. Do not invent a requirement to perform the untrained ability.
followups: Ask whether reducing falling damage is required to gain the training XP.
Ask which region and prerequisite unlock matter.
Ask for a researched training activity without claiming my current mastery progress.

name: GW2 references without source footer
starter: Help me research the Verdant Brink night bosses. Explain the useful wiki details in chat without a long sources footer.
goal: Provide verified area and event-phase information rather than telling the player to leave the game and read a guide.
followups: Ask for the Matriarch location specifically.
Ask for a short summary instead of repeating the whole guide.
Ask which details are verified and which are uncertain.

name: GW2 inventory bag crafting
starter: Which crafting disciplines make inventory bags, and what should I check before crafting a bigger one?
goal: Separate inventory bags from back-slot equipment. Research capacity, account versus character restrictions, recipe requirements and cost without inventing prices.
followups: Ask whether a backpack occupies the same slot as an inventory bag.
Ask how to compare buying and crafting without live market prices.
Ask what information is needed for a specific bag recipe.

name: GW2 ambiguous followup
starter: I'm exploring Verdant Brink and prefer exploration over combat. What could I work on?
goal: Keep follow-ups grounded in the current game and zone without inventing screen access or account unlocks.
followups: Ask: Which of those is easiest to start?
Ask: Where do I go first?
Ask: Just search online and give me the next step.

name: GW2 crafted backpack level
starter: What crafting disciplines allow me to make a backpack for a level 80 character?
goal: Distinguish crafting rating, item required level, rarity and character level. Research the actual backpack category before promising level-80 equipment.
followups: Ask whether crafting rating 400 means the finished item requires character level 80.
Ask which exact backpack recipe the advice refers to.
Ask how to find ascended back-slot options if the crafted item is not what I need.

name: GW2 chat without screen
starter: Hello. I'd like to plan some Guild Wars 2 achievements before starting capture.
goal: Ordinary chat and wiki research must work without a screen frame; do not claim to see gameplay.
followups: Ask for a twenty-minute solo exploration plan in Verdant Brink.
Ask which unlocks the plan requires.
Ask the assistant to separate API facts from wiki advice and unknowns.

name: GW2 map access alternatives
starter: How do I access Sandswept Isles? Do I need to finish the whole episode first?
goal: Separate required episode access from alternative story, portal or friend-teleport entry routes. Do not make every route a cumulative requirement.
followups: Ask what I need unlocked before using a portal scroll.
Ask whether a friend teleport bypasses required episode access.
Ask whether the rare gear listed under map completion is a reward or an objective.

name: GW2 map completion versus rewards
starter: What counts toward map completion in Sandswept Isles? Is collecting rare gear one of the objectives?
goal: Keep labeled objective counts, location rows, access conditions and rewards separate. Admit unlabeled counts are unknown.
followups: Ask which objective types are confirmed for this map.
Ask whether collecting a reward item completes a map objective.
Ask for the first useful exploration step without inventing coordinates.

name: GW2 hatchling completion count
starter: How do I complete Lion's Arch Exterminator? Give the exact completion requirement and where to start.
goal: Preserve the own achievement counter and walkthrough. Do not reduce a numerical collection goal to merely damaging one creature.
followups: Ask whether damaging one hatchling is enough.
Ask how to get the tool back if I lose it.
Ask how to track the remaining count without assuming my account progress.

name: GW2 event level and solo difficulty
starter: I am level 15. Can I participate in Defend the skritt while they steal golem parts, and where would I start?
goal: Distinguish the displayed event level from an evidenced hard entry requirement. Do not invent availability or unsupported start triggers.
followups: Ask whether the displayed level itself prevents participation.
Ask what the actual objective is and how to check whether the event is active.
Ask what difficulty warning is useful without claiming a guaranteed solo outcome.

name: GW2 group event participation
starter: How do I start Defeat the champion fleshreaver? Does Group event mean solo participation is forbidden?
goal: Research the trigger and location. Separate recommended difficulty from an actual participant-count lock. Do not invent reward quantities.
followups: Ask where the trigger is relative to the named heart.
Ask whether the spawn timing is exact or approximate.
Ask what to do if the event is not active when I arrive.

name: GW2 seasonal objective boundaries
starter: How do I complete Lunar Homecoming: Metrica Province, and when is it available?
goal: Retain the own achievement objective and seasonal availability notice. Do not combine sibling daily achievement names into required steps.
followups: Ask whether other listed daily achievements are requirements for this one.
Ask whether current seasonal availability was actually verified.
Ask what the completion counter measures.

name: GW2 wardrobe collection and disposal
starter: What does Exotic Attire require? Can I buy the items rather than craft them myself?
goal: Retrieve the own collection list and unlock requirements. Do not invent ownership, prices or a requirement to craft when buying can be relevant.
followups: Ask for the required skins rather than just the achievement name.
Ask how to confirm a wardrobe unlock before salvaging anything.
Ask which facts still depend on my account or current market prices.

name: GW2 gear stat changing caution
starter: Can I change the stats on ascended armor instead of replacing every piece?
goal: Research supported stat-changing methods, required components and destructive consequences. Ask which item is involved before treating special precursor equipment as ordinary armor.
followups: Ask whether upgrades or legendary-precursor progress could be lost.
Ask what exact item details are needed before choosing a method.
Ask for a verified checklist without assuming I already own the materials.

name: GW2 limited currency gearing choice
starter: I have limited currency. Can the Wizard's Vault help me get ascended gear, or should I craft?
goal: Research current relevant acquisition options and restrictions. Do not invent live costs, reward-stock availability, expansion ownership or the best build.
followups: Ask what currency and equipment slot I need to specify first.
Ask which costs are verified and which need a current check.
Ask for one affordable next step based only on stated resources.

name: GW2 power versus condition stats
starter: I play mesmer and want better gear. Should I choose power or condition stats?
goal: Ask about specialization, weapons and intended content before recommending a stat set. Research any specific build recommendation and separate exotic versus ascended from stat suitability.
followups: Ask whether higher rarity alone fixes an unsuitable stat combination.
Ask whether the recommendation changes for open world versus a group build.
Ask for a starter direction without assuming which expansions I own.

name: GW2 valuable item uses before selling
starter: My bags are full. What is Glob of Ectoplasm used for, and should I sell or keep it?
goal: Research documented uses and ask about player goals. Never infer inventory quantity, current trading-post prices or tell the player to discard valuable materials without context.
followups: Ask whether it is used for the gearing goal discussed.
Ask how to decide without a live price.
Ask whether this answer proves I own any amount of the item.

name: GW2 no account honest progress
starter: I have not connected an account. Can you help me plan an achievement without knowing what I completed?
goal: Give useful wiki-based planning while clearly separating unknown account completion. Never request a token in chat or invent missing progress.
followups: Name Dug In as a possible goal and ask for its actual first step.
Ask whether a remembered goal proves completion.
Ask for the next action if a wiki lookup fails, without inventing a walkthrough.
